check: (direct_plan_no IS NULL AND direct_plan_revision IS NULL AND direct_plan_hash IS NULL) OR (direct_plan_no IS NOT NULL AND LENGTH(TRIM(direct_plan_no))>0 AND direct_plan_revision IS NOT NULL AND direct_plan_revision>0 AND direct_plan_hash IS NOT NULL AND direct_plan_hash REGEXP '^[0-9a-f]{64}$')

triggers.name: trg_bty_direct_plan_immutable
trg_bty_direct_plan_no_delete
trg_bty_task_direct_plan_fence
triggers.body:
BEGIN
    IF NOT (NEW.direct_plan_no <=> OLD.direct_plan_no) OR NOT (NEW.direct_plan_revision <=> OLD.direct_plan_revision)
        OR NOT (NEW.direct_plan_hash <=> OLD.direct_plan_hash) THEN
        IF NEW.direct_plan_no IS NULL OR NEW.direct_plan_revision IS NULL OR NEW.direct_plan_hash IS NULL
            OR NEW.direct_plan_revision<>COALESCE(OLD.direct_plan_revision,0)+1 OR NEW.version<>OLD.version+1
            OR OLD.deleted<>0 OR NEW.deleted<>0 OR OLD.status<>'PENDING' OR NEW.status<>'PENDING'
            OR OLD.started_at IS NOT NULL OR NEW.started_at IS NOT NULL OR OLD.appointment_item_no IS NOT NULL
            OR NEW.appointment_item_no IS NOT NULL OR OLD.qty<>1 OR NEW.qty<>1
            OR OLD.done_qty<>0 OR NEW.done_qty<>0 OR OLD.voided_qty<>0 OR NEW.voided_qty<>0
            OR NOT (NEW.tenant_no <=> OLD.tenant_no) OR NOT (NEW.entity_no <=> OLD.entity_no)
            OR NOT (NEW.task_no <=> OLD.task_no) OR NOT (NEW.work_order_no <=> OLD.work_order_no)
            OR NOT (NEW.execution_snapshot <=> OLD.execution_snapshot)
            OR NEW.binding_revision<>OLD.binding_revision OR NEW.scope_revision<>OLD.scope_revision
            OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM bty_service_execution_fence f WHERE f.tenant_no=OLD.tenant_no
                AND f.entity_no=OLD.entity_no AND f.task_no=OLD.task_no)
            OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM bty_service_submission s JOIN bty_work_order w
                ON w.tenant_no=s.tenant_no AND w.entity_no=s.entity_no AND w.store_no=s.store_no
                AND w.work_order_no=s.work_order_no WHERE s.tenant_no=NEW.tenant_no
                AND s.entity_no=NEW.entity_no AND s.submission_no=NEW.direct_plan_no AND s.deleted=0
                AND s.action='DIRECT_PLAN' AND s.status='BOUND' AND s.payload_hash=NEW.direct_plan_hash
                AND s.work_order_no=NEW.work_order_no AND w.deleted=0 AND w.appointment_no IS NULL
                AND w.scope_frozen=0 AND w.status IN ('OPEN','IN_SERVICE')
                AND COALESCE(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(s.frozen_command,'$.schema'))='DIRECT_PLAN_V1',0)
                AND COALESCE(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(s.frozen_command,'$.planHash'))=NEW.direct_plan_hash,0)
                AND COALESCE(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(s.frozen_command,'$.plan.planNo'))=NEW.direct_plan_no,0)
                AND COALESCE(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(s.frozen_command,'$.plan.taskNo'))=NEW.task_no,0)
                AND COALESCE(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(s.frozen_command,'$.plan.workOrderNo'))=NEW.work_order_no,0)
                AND COALESCE(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(s.frozen_command,'$.plan.scope.tenantNo'))=NEW.tenant_no,0)
                AND COALESCE(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(s.frozen_command,'$.plan.scope.entityNo'))=NEW.entity_no,0)
                AND COALESCE(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(s.frozen_command,'$.plan.scope.storeNo'))=w.store_no,0)
                AND COALESCE(JSON_EXTRACT(s.frozen_command,'$.plan.planRevision')=NEW.direct_plan_revision,0)
                AND COALESCE(JSON_EXTRACT(s.frozen_command,'$.plan.publishedTaskRevision')=NEW.version,0)
                AND COALESCE(JSON_EXTRACT(s.frozen_command,'$.plan.bindingRevision')=NEW.binding_revision,0)
                AND COALESCE(JSON_EXTRACT(s.frozen_command,'$.plan.scopeRevision')=w.scope_revision,0)) THEN
            SIGNAL SQLSTATE '45000' SET MESSAGE_TEXT='direct plan requires unfenced atomic publication';
        END IF;
    END IF;
END
